match.reason: The bank point covers how economic and financial conditions affect a business's sales and costs, which is a different idea and depth from the VCE Economics point on the purpose of economic activity in meeting needs and wants and raising living standards.

draft.title: The purpose of economic activity
card: Economic activity is the making, selling and buying of goods and services. Goods are physical items, such as bread. Services are actions done for others, such as haircuts.
things people must have to live, such as food, water, shelter and clothing.
things people would like to have but can live without, such as a new phone or a holiday.
The purpose of economic activity is to meet needs and wants. When more of them are met, living standards rise.
draft.remember: Economic activity exists to meet needs and wants, and meeting more of them raises living standards.

a.q: Which choice best describes the purpose of economic activity?
opts: To meet people's needs and wants
To make sure every business earns a profit
To keep the prices of goods from changing
To move money from households to government
a.why: Goods and services are made, sold and bought so that people can meet their needs and wants. Profit may motivate a business, but it is not the purpose of economic activity for society as a whole.
a.clue: Think about why people make and buy things at all.

b.q: Ravi runs a bakery in Ballarat. He bakes bread and sells it to local families. Which statement best links his activity to living standards?
opts: Families meet a need for food, so living standards rise
Ravi earns income, so the whole town is better off
Bread is a want, so it does not affect living standards
Bread is baked, so the need for it no longer exists
b.why: Baking and selling bread is economic activity that meets a need for food. Meeting more needs and wants raises living standards. Bread is a need, not a want, so the third option is wrong.
b.clue: Ask what the families get from buying the bread.

a.best: To meet people's needs and wants

b.best: Families meet a need for food, so living standards rise
